claim: The sample demo uses separate storage, resets independently, never replaces real records, and can save an incomplete record.
where: demo banner, record builder, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; save a real record; enter ?demo=1; edit and reset; leave demo; verify the real record returns

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/; wait for service worker; set context offline; reload; assert filled sample

claim: Records and evidence stay on the device until the user exports a file.
where: landing facts, storage dialog, privacy page, README
sandbox: capture every request during demo save and export; assert same-origin GET requests only

claim: Default previews and exports redact common coordinate text, remove known location metadata containers, and round shared coordinates to the chosen precision.
sandbox: demo data plus DMS, labelled coordinates, JPEG COM, WAV INFO, and MP3 ID3 fixtures; decode exported attachments; select about 1 km and assert the preview and JSON use rounded coordinates

claim: A JPEG capture time can fill the observation time and remains editable.
sandbox: attach a JPEG with DateTimeOriginal in /demo/; assert prefill; edit and assert correction

claim: Location permission is requested only after the named button is pressed.
sandbox: instrument geolocation in /demo/; assert zero calls before the action and one call after it

claim: Downloads a PDF that lists evidence names and exports an importable JSON backup with up to ten files and 12 MB of evidence.
sandbox: filled /demo/ record; validate PDF header and sample evidence names; export and re-import a record at the 12 MB evidence boundary; accept ten files and reject an eleventh

claim: The tool does not identify a species or publish a sighting.
sandbox: filled /demo/ record; assert unverified notice and absence of identification or publishing actions

claim: The tool is free and needs no account.
sandbox: fresh /demo/; assert free fact, no sign-in link, password input, payment element, or purchase action

claim: The field illustration is original and was created with AI assistance.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ plus repository provenance files; match the shipped hero to the recorded source and prompt metadata

claim: No API key or backend is needed.
sandbox: fresh demo; save and export while recording requests; assert no credentials, non-GET request, or remote origin is used
replace the service-worker response with a fixture; assert the update toast, reload it, and confirm the replacement worker controls the reloaded page

claim: Deleting browser site data deletes records that were not exported.
sandbox: fresh /demo/ context; save a named record without export; clear the origin's browser storage; reload and assert the named record is absent while only the shipped sample is reseeded
